summary: Comprehensive audit of opencode provider loading and UI visibility mechanisms. The system uses a multi-layered loading approach with bundled providers, custom loaders, environment-based filtering, and configuration-based filtering. OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB mode is implemented but has duplicate code blocks and potential consistency issues.

environment_flags: OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB - Restricts all providers to github-copilot only (blocks external APIs)
OPENCODE_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_APIS - Blocks external HTTP requests and package loads
OPENCODE_DISABLE_MODELS_FETCH - Prevents fetching fresh models from models.dev
AWS_REGION - Sets AWS region for amazon-bedrock provider
AWS_PROFILE - Sets AWS profile for amazon-bedrock provider
GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, GCP_PROJECT, GCLOUD_PROJECT - Sets GCP project for google-vertex
GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION, VERTEX_LOCATION - Sets GCP location for google-vertex
AZURE_COGNITIVE_SERVICES_RESOURCE_NAME - Sets Azure cognitive services resource name
config_options: disabled_providers: Array of provider IDs to disable (disables providers that would load)
enabled_providers: Array of provider IDs to enable (allowlist mode - ONLY these providers available)
provider.<providerID>.env - Environment variables for API keys
provider.<providerID>.npm - NPM package for provider SDK
provider.<providerID>.whitelist - Model IDs to include (if set, only these available)
small_model - Small model for lightweight tasks

mechanisms: 2. Config-based filtering via enabled_providers (allowlist mode - takes precedence)
4. Model status filtering (alpha models require OPENCODE_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_MODELS flag)
5. Model deprecation filtering (deprecated models removed from UI)
7. Variant filtering (model variants can be disabled via configuration)
provider_filtering.disabled_providers_config: Array of provider IDs to disable. Providers in this list will not be loaded or displayed to users. Checked at multiple points: during provider merge, environment variable loading, API key loading, plugin loading, and custom loader execution. Takes precedence when OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB is NOT enabled.
provider_filtering.enabled_providers_config: Array of provider IDs to enable (allowlist mode). When set, ONLY providers in this list are available - all other providers are ignored. If BOTH disabled_providers and enabled_providers are set, enabled_providers takes precedence (allowlist wins). This provides a whitelist capability for locked-down environments.
provider_filtering.opencode_only_github_behavior: When OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB=1 environment variable is set: (1) ModelsDev.get() filters models to return ONLY github-copilot and github-copilot-enterprise entries; (2) Provider.list() ensures github-copilot providers are present even without env/auth/plugins; (3) Provider.defaultModel() falls back to github-copilot if no other providers available; (4) All external network requests are blocked (hostAllowed whitelist); (5) Only @ai-sdk/github-copilot package can be installed; (6) webfetch and websearch tools are disabled; (7) Plugin loading is restricted (INTERNAL_PLUGINS only); (8) ProviderRoutes further filters to github-copilot entries. This is designed for restricted environments like GitHub Actions runners.

ui_visibility.model_selection_logic: DialogModel component (dialog-model.tsx) displays models with categories: Favorites (starred models), Recent (recently used), All models grouped by provider. Favorites are stored in local state. Models are filtered to show: (1) Status check (deprecated removed); (2) Cost visibility (free models flagged); (3) Provider connection status (opencode provider nano models disabled); (4) Fuzzy search across model names and provider names. Provider filtering respects enabled_providers and disabled_providers. If only opencode provider available and no API key, free models shown. DialogProvider shows provider connection UI with OAuth/API key options.
ui_visibility.provider_list_endpoint: GET /api/provider returns { all: Provider[], default: {[providerID]: modelID}, connected: string[] }. Filters providers based on: (1) ModelsDev.get() result (respects OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB); (2) disabled_providers config; (3) enabled_providers config (allowlist if set); (4) Additional OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB filtering; (5) Merges with Provider.list() for real-time connection status. Provides default model for each provider based on priority sorting.

issues_found.issue: DUPLICATE CODE: OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB filtering logic is repeated 4 times in ModelsDev.get() function
issues_found.recommendation: Consolidate into single filtering function. Lines 140-148 and 150-158 are nearly identical. Extract to helper function and call once. This blocks network fetch AND filters results unnecessarily twice.

issues_found.issue: INCONSISTENCY: getRawModels() returns minimal github-copilot hardcoded data but get() tries to fetch and parse anyway
issues_found.recommendation: If getRawModels() returns minimal data for OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB, the get() function should not attempt to refresh/refetch. Either return early in getRawModels() OR handle refresh differently. Currently creates inconsistent state between getRawModels return and get() processing.

issues_found.issue: MISSING VALIDATION: enabled_providers allowlist doesn't validate against disabled_providers overlap
issues_found.recommendation: If a provider is in both enabled_providers (allowlist) AND disabled_providers (blocklist), behavior is undefined. Add validation: if enabled_providers exists, ignore disabled_providers OR throw error on conflict. Currently enabled_providers logic doesn't check disabled list.

issues_found.issue: HARDCODED FILTERING: OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB filtering is hardcoded in 6+ locations (provider.ts, models.ts, plugin.ts, auth.ts, server routes)
issues_found.location: Multiple files: provider.ts:710-712, models.ts:104-131, models.ts:140-195, plugin.ts, auth.ts, server/routes/provider.ts:51-55
issues_found.recommendation: Create a single provider filtering function that respects: (1) enabled_providers allowlist, (2) disabled_providers blocklist, (3) OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB flag, (4) OPENCODE_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_APIS flag. Use this consistently across all code paths. Consider a ProviderFilter namespace.

issues_found.issue: INCOMPLETE EGRESS BLOCKING: OPENCODE_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_APIS only blocks @ai-sdk/github-copilot, but ModelsDev.refresh() uses fetch()
issues_found.recommendation: refresh() should check isEgressBlocked() before fetching. Currently, while provider loader checks packageAllowed(), ModelsDev.refresh() doesn't respect OPENCODE_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_APIS or OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB. If egress is blocked, should skip network fetch entirely.

issues_found.issue: CONFIG PRECEDENCE UNCLEAR: enabled_providers is described as allowlist but interaction with disabled_providers not documented
issues_found.recommendation: Document: 'When enabled_providers is set, only these providers are available. disabled_providers is ignored. This provides blocklist-or-allowlist semantics.' Add test case covering both configs set simultaneously.

issues_found.issue: UNUSED FALLBACK: Provider.defaultModel() falls back to opencode/gpt-5-nano even when small_model config could specify it
issues_found.recommendation: getSmallModel() respects small_model config, but defaultModel() has hardcoded priority list that ignores config value. Consider using config value if available, else fallback to priority list.

issues_found.issue: GITHUB-COPILOT ENTERPRISE INHERITANCE: Enterprise variant created dynamically from GitHub Copilot but not documented
issues_found.recommendation: Document that github-copilot-enterprise is a runtime-generated variant that mirrors github-copilot models and inherits auth. If org wants to disable one, must disable both to avoid confusion.

issues_found.issue: MODEL LOADER REGISTRY NOT EXPOSED: Custom model loaders (CUSTOM_LOADERS) are internal, no way for plugins to register custom loaders
issues_found.recommendation: If plugins need custom model loading logic, provide mechanism to register. Currently baked into provider.ts. Consider extracting to pluggable system.

issues_found.issue: NO ERROR ON MISCONFIGURATION: If enabled_providers references non-existent provider, silently ignored
issues_found.recommendation: Warn or error if enabled_providers includes provider IDs that don't exist in database. Currently creates silent failures when users typo provider names in config.

notes: BUNDLED ONLY: Only @ai-sdk/github-copilot is bundled. All other providers are installed dynamically via npm/yarn (respecting egress policy).
SDK CACHING: Provider SDKs are cached by xxHash32 of (npm_package_name + options). Same SDK configuration reused across calls.
CUSTOM LOADERS DETERMINE AUTOLOAD: Each custom loader returns { autoload: boolean, getModel?, options }. If autoload=true OR provider already loaded, options are merged and loader registered.
PLUGIN AUTH TAKES PRECEDENCE: Plugin-provided auth can load providers even if not in database (via mergeProvider).

MODEL FILTERING CHAIN: Models go through: (1) Status filter (alpha requires flag, deprecated removed), (2) Config blacklist/whitelist, (3) Variant filtering (disabled variants removed). Applied at load time.
TUI SHOWS CONNECTED STATUS: dialog-model.tsx uses useConnected() to show popular providers when not connected. Uses fuzzy search for model discovery.
PROVIDER/MODEL PRIORITY: Models sorted by: gpt-5 > claude-sonnet-4 > big-pickle > gemini-3-pro (contains 'latest' versions ranked first).
OPENCODE PROVIDER SPECIAL: opencode provider (free tier) deletes all paid models if no API key. Free models always shown if opencode available.
VARIANT SYSTEM: Models can have variants (e.g., different region configs for bedrock). Variants disabled via config are filtered out.
CUSTOM FETCH WRAPPER: All provider SDKs wrapped with timeout handling, Azure ID stripping, and custom fetch support.
REGION HANDLING: Amazon Bedrock has complex region prefixing logic (us., eu., ap., au., jp., apac.) based on model and region config.
GITHUB COPILOT RESPONSES API: gpt-5+ models use responses() API instead of chat(). Special handling for gpt-5-mini and enterprise variants.
